title: The Children's Question
text: A child stops a drone in the corridor. "The Vell sing about a guardian that burned its people. Are you a guardian?"

choices.label: "I don't know what they mean."
choices.reply: The child thinks about it. "That's not a no." They run off before we can answer.

choices.label: "It's only a story."
choices.reply: "Okay." The child believes us. We log the conversation anyway.
